12.name: Episode 1
12.overview: Julia Morris and Robert Irwin introduce the new celebs bravely facing our toughest season ever! Who will enter the jungle this year, and how long will they last?

12.name: Episode 2
12.overview: The celebrities face a dizzying trial. Two new stars arrive in the grim Elephant's Graveyard. Who will win their freedom, and who will be banished into exile?

12.name: Episode 3
12.overview: One star confronts terrifying heights. Meanwhile, an exile leads to a battle for freedom. Who will be left in the dark?

12.name: Episode 4
12.overview: The exiled Celebrities in the Elephant's Graveyard continue their Head-to-Head Challenge to win their way back to the camp, also the Celebrities also face a dreaded food trial!

12.name: Episode 5
12.overview: The camp celebrates a reunion and a hard-earned dinner. However, passive-aggressive friction peaks between two celebrities, while a new arrival joins camp.

12.name: Episode 6
12.overview: A new Celebrity chef serves a standout feast and the group receives a luxury surprise. The Bone Phone's call sends four Celebs to a breathtaking trial and camp tensions reach a boiling point.

12.name: Episode 7
12.overview: Two new Captains must divide the camp for a "dynamite" trial. While some celebs get cheeky with a mock-romance class, others hit breaking point, leading to a shock exit that no one saw coming!

12.name: Episode 8
12.overview: As hunger grows, teams face off for treats before four Celebrities are picked for an eating trial. Shock ripples through camp as a survival battle determines who stays and who leaves first.

12.name: Episode 9
12.overview: A tense game of bluff ends in the first elimination, while the remaining Celebrities bond over family stories. A grueling snake trial leaves one team on top, but dinner brings unexpected friction.

12.name: Episode 10
12.overview: The Green and Gold Teams face off in a smashing challenge, a Celebrity Bachelor is looking for love, and a nerve-racking trial will take two celebrities to new heights.

12.name: Episode 11
12.overview: Camp fun peaks with a restaurant role-play and a wild wig party! Things get serious when the "Bone Phone" forces a tough elimination vote, leading to an emotional dinner and a heartfelt farewell.

12.name: Episode 12
12.overview: The camp processes a sudden departure while a prank war ignites between Celebrities. After a grueling trial, the team returns with a story that leaves everyone guessing what's for dinner!

12.name: Episode 13
12.overview: One Celebrity does an undercover mission to try and win a camp pamper session. But the relaxation ends when an elimination choice leads to a heated confrontation.

12.name: Episode 14
12.overview: One celebrity returns from the Boat of Doom elimination, rain hits hard in camp, and 2 celebrities are forced to face their fears in a real stinker of a trial!

12.name: Episode 15
12.overview: Two celebrities are summoned by the Bone Phone to a gruesome bug-filled trial. The boys choose two celebrities for the next emotional elimination.

12.name: Episode 16
12.overview: One Celebrity goes undercover for a secret food mission while others face their fears in a new trial. After a lighthearted breakfast date, a random twist puts two campmates at risk.

12.name: Episode 17
12.overview: Tears flow as the camp receives emotional letters from home. To lift the mood, the Celebrities share funny audition stories and compete in a "Jungle Olympics" before a surprise trial team is named.

12.name: Episode 18
12.overview: Two campmates brave a cave trial for food before the group faces a blindfolded trivia battle. Suspended over a mud pit, one celebrity takes the fall and is eliminated.

12.name: Episode 19
12.overview: All six Celebrities are thrust into a thrilling trial! Later, they must all vote for which Celebrity they want to see in the Finale and the 2 celebrities with the least votes are up for elimination.

12.name: Episode 20
12.overview: In the biggest elimination episode ever, the final six becomes the Top 3. Which campmate trio will battle their way into the Grand Finale?

12.name: Episode 21
12.overview: The Top 3 are surprised by a visit from their loved ones on their final morning. After an emotional goodbye to camp, it's off to the finale to crown the new King or Queen of the Jungle!

lastEpisodeToAir.overview: The Top 3 are surprised by a visit from their loved ones on their final morning. After an emotional goodbye to camp, it's off to the finale to crown the new King or Queen of the Jungle!

originalTitle: I'm a Celebrity: Get Me Out of Here!
overview: Australian celebrities are dropped into the African jungle with little more than their wits, strength and willpower to survive the competition. How will they cope with African wildlife, a constant series of challenges and tests, basic rations and their fellow campmates? Who will survive the infamous Bush Tucker Trials? Who will win the hearts of viewers and be crowned King or Queen of the Jungle?

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: I'm A Celebrity returns to the South African Jungle for the first time after the COVID pandemic.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Australia's "I'm a Celebrity…Get Me Out of Here!" is back for its 10th series. Hosted by Australian comedian Julia Morris, and for the first time, wildlife warrior, Robert Irwin.

title: I'm a Celebrity: Get Me Out of Here!
